about.title: About Arlington ISD
about.content: Arlington Independent School District serves students and families in Arlington, Texas, in Tarrant County within the Dallas-Fort Worth-Arlington metro area. The Arlington ISD calendar is especially important for families coordinating school start dates, student holidays, parent conference days, early dismissal schedules, bad weather make-up days, and major breaks across elementary, secondary, A/B, and Early College High School calendars. Because Arlington sits between Dallas and Fort Worth, many families compare Arlington ISD dates with nearby North Texas districts before booking travel, arranging childcare, planning commutes, or coordinating shared custody and transportation schedules.

about.title: How to Use This Arlington ISD Calendar
about.content: Use this page for districtwide school-year planning. Arlington ISD may publish separate student academic calendars for elementary and secondary students, so families should check the notes on the relevant school year and confirm campus-specific events, athletics, testing schedules, graduation dates, and emergency updates with the district or assigned school.

planningTips.title: Planning Tips for Arlington ISD Families
content: Check whether your student follows the elementary, secondary, A/B, or Early College High School calendar before making final plans.
Track parent conference days and early dismissal dates because they can affect childcare, transportation, and pickup times.
Treat bad weather make-up days as conditional planning dates until Arlington ISD confirms whether missed instructional time must be recovered.
Use the official Arlington ISD calendar page for revisions, campus-specific events, emergency closures, and same-day announcements.

districtFaqs.q: Which Arlington ISD calendar does this page summarize?
districtFaqs.a: This page summarizes Arlington ISD student academic calendar dates for the listed school years. For 2026-2027, Arlington ISD publishes separate elementary and secondary student academic calendar PDFs, and this page merges shared dates while noting grade-level differences.

districtFaqs.q: Does Arlington ISD publish separate elementary and secondary calendars?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Arlington ISD publishes separate Elementary Student Academic Calendar and Secondary Student Academic Calendar PDFs for 2026-2027. The calendars share most major dates, but some early dismissal dates differ by level.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Arlington ISD calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Arlington ISD calendars page and school announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Arlington ISD.

districtFaqs.q: Can I add the Arlington ISD calendar to Google Calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Use the calendar download section on this page to download the Arlington ISD .ics file, then import it into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. The import is a one-time calendar file, so families should recheck Arlington ISD for later revisions.

districtFaqs.q: Does Arlington ISD have early dismissal days?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The 2026-2027 Arlington ISD elementary and secondary calendars list early dismissal dates. Elementary early dismissal is listed on December 18, 2026 and May 26, 2027. Secondary early dismissal is listed on December 17-18, 2026, May 25, 2027, and May 26, 2027.

districtFaqs.q: Is this the official Arlington ISD calendar?
districtFaqs.a: No. MySchoolDates is an independent calendar reference. This page summarizes Arlington ISD dates from official district calendar sources and links back to Arlington ISD for final confirmation.

districtFaqs.q: Where can I download the Arlington ISD calendar PDF?
districtFaqs.a: Use the PDF links on this page or the official Arlington ISD calendars page to download the elementary, secondary, Early College High School, or A/B calendar PDF that applies to your student.
